Title: Peer Tutor & Mentor Support
Description: Get matched with free peer tutoring or mentoring for coursework, board preparation, clerkships, and student life.
Keywords: academic support tutor tutoring mentor mentoring study usmle step shelf exam appointment request form oasc
Detail 1: Use Einstein’s Peer Support Network to request a tutor or mentor matched to your needs.
Detail 2: Peer tutoring is available for basic science and systems courses, USMLE Step 1 and Step 2, shelf exams, and study strategy.
Detail 3: Scheduling is arranged directly between you and your tutor or mentor.

Title: Laundry in Student Housing
Description: Find the school's housing guidance for using and monitoring residence-hall laundry machines.
Keywords: washer dryer washing clothes residence apartment hercules cp mobile app housing faq
Detail 1: The official housing FAQ directs residents to the Hercules CP Mobile app for laundry.
Detail 2: Use the app to manage laundry and check a machine’s status while it is in use.
Detail 3: Open the housing FAQ for the latest housing instructions and related contacts.

Title: Housing Work Order
Description: Submit a maintenance request for an issue in Einstein student housing through the housing work-order portal.
Keywords: repair maintenance apartment residence broken leak ac heat internet request archibus emergency facilities
Detail 1: Open the housing work-order portal and sign in with your Einstein credentials.
Detail 2: Describe the problem and include enough detail for the maintenance team to locate and assess it.
Detail 3: For an after-hours housing emergency such as flooding, loss of power, fire, or a gas odor, contact the 1935 security desk.

Title: EinsteinSecure Wi-Fi
Description: Enroll a phone or computer on EinsteinSecure with the SecureW2 setup flow for your device.
Keywords: wifi wi-fi internet wireless network connect certificate securew2 windows mac iphone android password it setup
Detail 1: Open the enrollment link from the device you want to connect and follow the SecureW2 prompts.
Detail 2: Authenticate once with your Montefiore Active Directory credentials when prompted.
Detail 3: After installing the profile or wrapper, select EinsteinSecure when you are on campus.

Title: Jury Duty Guidance
Description: Review school guidance and documentation for responding to a jury-duty summons while enrolled.
Keywords: court summons civic service absence attendance postponement deferment letter policy documentation
Detail 1: Open the school’s jury-duty document before responding to a summons.
Detail 2: Confirm any attendance, documentation, or scheduling requirements with Student Affairs if your service could affect coursework or clinical duties.
Detail 3: Because court and school requirements can change, use the linked document as the current point of reference.

Title: Clerkship Shuttle & E-Car
Description: Check clerkship transportation between Belfer and Montefiore-Moses, plus E-Car reservation and safety guidance.
Keywords: transport bus route schedule ride car service clerkship moses belfer ecar best deal commute
Detail 1: The clerkship shuttle runs between Belfer at 1300 Morris Park Avenue and Montefiore-Moses on weekdays.
Detail 2: For other supported clerkship locations or off-hours travel, use the E-Car reservation system described in the guide.
Detail 3: Match the arriving vehicle and license plate to your confirmation before getting in.

Title: Student Health Insurance
Description: Find current health-insurance budget information and the school’s note about waiving coverage with a comparable plan.
Keywords: coverage plan waive waiver comparable insurance premium cost fee benefits medical anthem finance budget
Detail 1: Review the current M.D. cost-of-attendance page for the student health-insurance budget line.
Detail 2: The school notes that student health insurance may be waived with proof of comparable insurance.
Detail 3: Confirm deadlines, plan terms, and waiver documentation with the responsible school office before taking action.

Title: Student Mental Health Center
Description: Access free, confidential counseling, medication consultation, group therapy, and referrals for longer-term care.
Keywords: counseling therapist therapy stress anxiety depression crisis confidential psychiatry appointment wellness support 988
Detail 1: The center offers free, confidential mental health services to Einstein students and trainees by appointment.
Detail 2: Available care includes short-term counseling, medication consultation and management, and group psychotherapy.
Detail 3: Appointments may be in person or virtual. Call the center or use the official page for current scheduling details.

Title: Student Health Center
Description: Schedule primary care, preventive services, immunizations, sexual health care, or a referral to specialty care.
Keywords: doctor primary care appointment physical illness injury immunization vaccine sexual health mychart clinic occupational exposure medical
Detail 1: The Student Health Center provides primary care and preventive services by appointment; it does not offer walk-in visits.
Detail 2: Schedule through MyChart or call during office hours. The center tries to accommodate same-day visits when possible.
Detail 3: The center is at 1180 Morris Park Avenue, floor 2, room 220.
